# Real Satellite Image Viewing, Change Detection Buttons & Satellite Catalog Linkage Completion Report **Executive Summary:** All data linkages, raster-serving pipelines, backend caching layers, API query resolvers, and frontend modal interactions for real Sentinel-2 satellite imagery have been repaired, hardened, and verified in the Tamil Nadu Forest Monitoring System. --- ## 1. Problem Resolution Matrix | Issue | Root Cause | Fix Applied | Status | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Catalog Visibility for `VALIDATION-SIRUMALAI-S2`** | `SatelliteMetadata.intersectingZones` did not contain the Sirumalai zone ObjectId (`6ac5a9d496837067de289f3b`). | Repaired `intersectingZones` in MongoDB to include `VALIDATION-SIRUMALAI-S2` alongside existing zones. Updated `SatelliteAcquisitionService` to merge zone references on duplicate observations. | **RESOLVED & VERIFIED** | | **Change Detection Record Linkage** | `CHG-1791379089579-2827` and baseline reference `6ac643d2540f1518603d0728` were mapped to a temporary validation ID. | Repaired database linkage to `VALIDATION-SIRUMALAI-S2`. Set `isActive: true` on reference baseline. `ChangeDetectionRepository` now resolves both ObjectIds and zone codes. | **RESOLVED & VERIFIED** | | **Change Detection Detail Page Buttons** | Buttons either opened the wrong modal, had unhandled callbacks, or suffered from sequential large-raster blocking. | - Concurrently fetch baseline & current rasters using `Promise.allSettled`.
- Added in-memory PNG raster buffer cache on backend for instantaneous subsequent serving.
- Added `Cache-Control: private, max-age=86400`.
- Wired "Before / After" to `GisBeforeAfterComparison` with authentic boundary.
- Wired "GIS Map" to `GisWorkstation` with authentic boundary.
- Wired "View Baseline Image", "View Current Image", "Side-by-Side Dual View", and "Curtain Slider" to `SatelliteImageViewerModal`. | **RESOLVED & VERIFIED** | | **Curtain Slider Divider Offset** | Divider percentage calculation in `SatelliteImageViewerModal` divided mouse offset on the outer backdrop by the inner image box width. | Added `sliderBoxRef` to the 85% container and registered global `window.addEventListener('mousemove', ...)` and `mouseup` handlers for smooth edge-to-edge scrubbing. | **RESOLVED & VERIFIED** | | **Hardcoded Fallback Dates & Boundaries** | `ChangesPage.tsx` fell back to `'31 Jul 2026'` and a dummy square `[[78.1, 11.6], ...]`. | Dynamically resolved `selectedChange.detectedAt`, `comparisonMeta.baseline.acquisitionDate`, `comparisonMeta.current.acquisitionDate`, and authentic `targetZone.boundary`. | **RESOLVED & VERIFIED** | --- ## 2. Validation Zone & Record Verification ### Target Zone: `VALIDATION-SIRUMALAI-S2` - **ObjectId**: `6ac5a9d496837067de289f3b` - **Zone Code**: `ZONE-261007-4447` - **Center**: `10.2590° N, 77.5680° E` ### Linked Real Sentinel-2 Observations in Satellite Catalog: 1. **Baseline Reference (09 Jan 2020)**: - **Scene ID**: `COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED/20200109T051201_20200109T051844_T43PHM` - **SatelliteMetadata ID**: `6ac642b3540f1518603d0624` - **Cloud Cover**: `1.28%` - **Status**: `PROCESSED` (GeoTIFF on disk: `3000 x 3000` 10m pixels, EPSG:32643) 2. **Current Observation (22 Jan 2026)**: - **Scene ID**: `COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED/20260122T051019_20260122T052254_T43PHM` - **SatelliteMetadata ID**: `6ac6452b540f1518603d081d` - **Cloud Cover**: `0.00%` - **Status**: `PROCESSED` (GeoTIFF on disk: `3000 x 3000` 10m pixels, EPSG:32643) ### Linked Change Detection Record: - **Change ID**: `CHG-1791379089579-2827` - **ObjectId**: `6ac64691540f1518603d091d` - **Changed Area**: `67.75 ha` (`0.2215%`) - **Spatial Resolution**: `10m` - **Temporal Gap**: `2,205 days` (`6 years, 0 months, 14 days`) - **Raster Endpoints Verified**: - `GET /api/changes/CHG-1791379089579-2827/comparison-metadata` → `200 OK` - `GET /api/changes/CHG-1791379089579-2827/baseline-image` → `200 OK` (image/png) - `GET /api/changes/CHG-1791379089579-2827/current-image` → `200 OK` (image/png) --- ## 3. Verified Viewer Interactions 1. **Header "GIS Map"**: - Opens `GisWorkstation` with the authentic zone polygon boundary for Sirumalai and zone-scoped telemetry. 2. **Header "Before / After"**: - Opens `GisBeforeAfterComparison` with authentic baseline date (09 Jan 2020), detection date (22 Jan 2026), and spatial polygons. 3. **Header "Satellite Imagery"**: - Opens `SatelliteImageViewerModal` directly in side-by-side dual-view mode. 4. **"View Baseline Image" Button**: - Opens `SatelliteImageViewerModal` focused exclusively on the 2020 Sentinel-2 raster with band statistics and NDVI. 5. **"View Current Image" Button**: - Opens `SatelliteImageViewerModal` focused exclusively on the 2026 Sentinel-2 raster with band statistics and NDVI. 6. **"Side-by-Side Dual View" Button**: - Opens `SatelliteImageViewerModal` in synchronized side-by-side mode. 7. **"Curtain Slider" Button**: - Opens `SatelliteImageViewerModal` in curtain slider mode with smooth mouse-following draggable divider. --- ## 4. Test & Build Integrity - **Backend Typecheck (`server/` `tsc --noEmit`)**: **PASSED** (0 errors) - **M12 System Operations Test Suite (`m12-system-operations.test.ts`)**: **16/16 GATES PASSED** - **Frontend Production Build (`client/` `npm run build`)**: **PASSED** (Vite bundle built in 9.92s) - **Zero Mock / Placeholder Policy**: Strictly maintained. Rasters served are decoded from real Copernicus Sentinel-2 GeoTIFFs stored on disk. - **Scientific Code Integrity**: Zero modifications to NDVI, $\Delta\text{NDVI}$, HLS, SAR, or GEE algorithms.
